statement: Let (Ω, g, K) be smooth initial data on a connected manifold with one end and nonempty compact smooth boundary S = ⨆︁r i=1 Si, where r < ∞ and each Si is connected. Orient S into Ω, and suppose HS + trS K = 0, A = Areag(S) > 0. A full enclosing cut means the entire compact boundary of a connected closed exterior domain containing the sufficiently distant end, with its manifold interior in int Ω. Its normal points toward that end, and all components and all coincidence with S count. Assume S is outer area-minimizing for these smooth cuts. Let T be a measurable family of full minimizing frontiers, equipped with a probability measure ϖ. Assume the following geometric properties. 23 1. Every T ∈ T has area A, lies in one fixed compact subset of Ω, and is a compact embedded two-sided C1,α hypersurface without boundary, for some 0 < α < 1. It is the entire boundary of a connected closed C1 exterior domain containing the distant end. Its manifold interior lies in int Ω, and the coorientation of T points toward that end. In particular, whenever T is smooth it is a full enclosing cut of the stated comparison class. 2. The free part T \ S is smooth and minimal. At contact with S, its graph functions are locally W2,2, its filled side contains the original obstacle, and its normal agrees with that of S. Thus its local graph lies on the exterior side of the obstacle graph. 3. The surface-area measures form a measurable kernel in T. On the union of the free frontiers there is a single Borel tangent-plane field Π(x), continuous relative to that union, such that Π(x) = TxT whenever x ∈ T \ S. Suppose also that ∫︂ T ∫︂ T s trTxT K(x) dAg(x) dϖ(T) = 0 (︁ s ∈ C∞ c (int Ω) )︁ . (4.19) Then, for ϖ-almost every T, the whole frontier is a smooth MOTS, its free part satisfies HT = trT K = 0, and each of its connected components is either an entire Si or is compactly contained in int Ω. Moreover, ϖ{T : T = S} = 1 under either of the following hypotheses: (a) S is connected, and no compact smooth embedded two-sided full enclosing cut lying wholly in int Ω, possibly disconnected, has θ+ ≤ 0 everywhere. (b) No full smooth enclosing cut has all components either equal to entire original components Si or wholly in int Ω, at least one component in that open exterior, and θ+ ≤ 0 everywhere. In case (a), before outermostness is applied, almost every frontier satisfies the sharper dichotomy: it equals S, or it is wholly interior and satisfies HT = trT K = 0 everywhere. In either localization case, for every continuous symmetric tensor h, ∫︂ T 1 2 ∫︂ T trTxT h dAg dϖ(T) = 1 2 ∫︂ S trS h dAg. (4.20)
